predicates.title: AKS API server publicly accessible
predicates.description: The AKS API server is reachable from the internet: the cluster is not private and no authorized IP ranges are configured.
predicates.recommendation: Use a private cluster or restrict API access with authorized IP ranges.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' | extend ap = properties.apiServerAccessProfile | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, enablePrivateCluster = tobool(ap.enablePrivateCluster), authorizedIpRangeCount = array_length(ap.authorizedIPRanges)

predicates.title: AKS local accounts / admin kubeconfig enabled
predicates.description: AKS local accounts are enabled on an Entra-integrated cluster, allowing cluster-admin kubeconfig (listClusterAdminCredential) that bypasses Entra RBAC.
predicates.attack_vector: listClusterAdminCredential -> cluster admin bypassing identity controls
predicates.recommendation: Set disableLocalAccounts=true and enforce Entra RBAC for Kubernetes.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, disableLocalAccounts = tobool(properties.disableLocalAccounts), aadProfileEnabled = isnotnull(properties.aadProfile)

predicates.title: AKS cluster without network policy
predicates.description: The cluster has no network policy engine, leaving pod-to-pod traffic unrestricted.
predicates.recommendation: Enable Azure or Calico network policy and define deny-by-default policies.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, networkPolicy = tostring(properties.networkProfile.networkPolicy)

predicates.title: AKS cluster not integrated with Entra ID / Kubernetes RBAC
predicates.description: An AKS cluster does not use Entra ID integration with Azure RBAC for Kubernetes: Kubernetes RBAC is disabled, aadProfile is absent, or Azure RBAC for Kubernetes is not enabled.
predicates.attack_vector: Weak cluster authZ -> over-broad Kubernetes access, hard-to-revoke credentials
predicates.recommendation: Enable Entra ID integration with Azure RBAC for Kubernetes; enable Kubernetes RBAC; disable local accounts.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, enableRBAC = tobool(properties.enableRBAC), aadProfileEnabled = isnotnull(properties.aadProfile), enableAzureRBAC = tobool(properties.aadProfile.enableAzureRBAC)

predicates.title: AKS Pod Security Standards not enforced / privileged pods allowed
predicates.description: A non-system namespace lacks a pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=baseline|restricted label, or a running pod uses a privileged security context, host namespaces, a hostPath mount, or does not require runAsNonRoot.
predicates.attack_vector: Privileged/host-namespaced pod -> escape to node -> cluster compromise
predicates.recommendation: Label namespaces with pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted (baseline minimum); deny privileged, hostPath and host namespaces; require runAsNonRoot, drop ALL capabilities, and seccomp RuntimeDefault.

query.kql: kubectl get ns -o json (enforce label) + kubectl get pods -A -o json (read-only): rows projected per object as { kind, name, namespace, isSystem, podSecurityEnforce, privileged, hostNetwork, hostPID, hostIPC, hasHostPath, runAsNonRoot }

predicates.title: Container workload publicly exposed without ingress controls
predicates.description: A Container Apps workload exposes external ingress with no IP security restrictions, or a Container Instances group has a public IP with open ports.
predicates.attack_vector: Internet-exposed container -> direct application attack / lateral movement
predicates.recommendation: Restrict ingress to known sources, require authentication, prefer internal ingress + private networking.

query.kql: Resources | where type in ('microsoft.app/containerapps','microsoft.containerinstance/containergroups') | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, ingressExternal = tobool(properties.configuration.ingress.external), ipRestrictionCount = array_length(properties.configuration.ingress.ipSecurityRestrictions), hasPublicIp = (tostring(properties.ipAddress.type) == 'Public')

predicates.title: Container Registry admin user enabled
predicates.description: The ACR admin account is enabled, providing a shared credential instead of identity-based pull.
predicates.attack_vector: Shared registry credential theft -> image pull/push
predicates.recommendation: Disable the admin user; use managed identity or token-based access.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.containerregistry/registries' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, adminUserEnabled = tobool(properties.adminUserEnabled)

predicates.title: Container Registry public network access without IP rules, or anonymous pull
predicates.description: An Azure Container Registry permits public network connectivity without IP rules and/or anonymous image pull. Public reachability alone does not prove unauthenticated image access.
predicates.attack_vector: Public registry endpoint -> increased credential-attack surface; anonymous pull, when enabled, exposes images
predicates.recommendation: Restrict public network access (private endpoint / network rules); disable anonymous pull.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.containerregistry/registries' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicNetworkAccess = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess), networkRuleCount = array_length(properties.networkRuleSet.ipRules), anonymousPullEnabled = tobool(properties.anonymousPullEnabled)

predicates.title: Defender for Containers registry vulnerability scanning not enabled
predicates.description: Microsoft Defender for Containers is on the Free tier or absent for the subscription, so images pushed to ACR are not continuously scanned for known CVEs.
predicates.attack_vector: Unscanned image with critical CVE deployed -> exploitable workload / supply-chain foothold
predicates.recommendation: Enable Defender for Containers (Standard tier) for registry and runtime scanning; gate promotion on scan results.

query.kql: az security pricing show -n Containers -> row { subscriptionId, name: 'Containers', pricingTier }

predicates.title: Container Registry content trust / quarantine not enabled
predicates.description: A Premium registry does not enforce content trust (image signing) or quarantine, so unsigned or unscanned images can be pulled and run with no integrity guarantee.
predicates.attack_vector: Unsigned/tampered image pulled -> implant internal image -> compromised workload
predicates.recommendation: Enable content trust and quarantine on a Premium registry; require signed images via admission; enable tag immutability.

query.kql: az acr config content-trust show + az acr show (policies) -> row { id, name, sku, trustPolicyStatus, quarantinePolicyStatus }

predicates.title: Deployed container image with known critical/high CVEs or mutable tag
predicates.description: An image referenced by a workload carries a Defender for Containers critical/high vulnerability finding, or is pinned to a mutable :latest tag instead of a digest.
predicates.attack_vector: Exploit known CVE in running image -> code execution -> container escape / lateral movement
predicates.recommendation: Rebuild/patch affected images, pin to digests, rescan, and redeploy; block deployment of images with critical findings via admission control.

query.kql: az security assessment list (container image findings) -> row { id, image, tag, defenderSeverity, subscriptionId, resourceGroup }

predicates.title: AKS not sourcing secrets via the Secrets Store CSI driver / Key Vault
predicates.description: The cluster does not enable the Azure Key Vault provider for the Secrets Store CSI driver, indicating workloads likely source secrets from plaintext Kubernetes Secrets, manifests, or environment variables.
predicates.attack_vector: Plaintext Kubernetes Secret / env var -> secret theft from a compromised pod or etcd read
predicates.recommendation: Enable the Azure Key Vault provider for Secrets Store CSI driver, bind it to a workload identity with least privilege, and enable secret auto-rotation.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, keyvaultSecretsProviderEnabled = tobool(properties.addonProfiles.azureKeyvaultSecretsProvider.enabled)

predicates.title: AKS deployment admission / image-integrity control not enforced
predicates.description: The cluster has no native deployment-time admission control governing images: Azure Policy for AKS is disabled and/or the Image Cleaner is disabled. The agent confirms whether an equivalent admission controller (Gatekeeper/Kyverno/Ratify) compensates.
predicates.attack_vector: No deploy gate -> unsigned/vulnerable image runs -> supply-chain foothold
predicates.recommendation: Enable Azure Policy for AKS with Pod Security and image-source baselines; require signed images via admission; enable Image Cleaner.

query.kql: Resources | where type == 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, azurePolicyEnabled = tobool(properties.addonProfiles.azurepolicy.enabled), imageCleanerEnabled = tobool(properties.securityProfile.imageCleaner.enabled)
